episodes.synopsis: The Detective Boys are at a small ski resort and meet up with four graduate students who are building a snowman for an art project. Later that evening, Sakuko Kokura, one of the graduate students, become lost in the blizzard and the two groups begin their search for her. Conan finds the Kokura dead at the bottom of a cliff in a lake. The police declares that Kokura's death was a snowboarding accident. Conan notices that the body is missing a hat, goggles, and gloves and believes that she was murdered and one of the graduate students is the culprit.
episodes.title: The Unbreakable Snowman (1)

episodes.synopsis: Conan realizes how the murder was done and gathers the suspects along with inspector Misao Yamamura.
episodes.title: The Unbreakable Snowman (2)

episodes.synopsis: The Junior Detective League head to a pond to witness animal control officers attempting to capture an alligator snapping turtle that is loose in the wild.
episodes.title: The Mysterious Case Near the Pond

episodes.synopsis: Takeyori Oikawa claims that the Phantom Thief Kid is targeting his painting which is to be unveiled to the world live that day. The painting is a final part of a set of four. He hires Kogoro Mori to protect the painting from Kid.
episodes.title: Phantom Thief Kid and the 4 Masterpieces (1)

episodes.synopsis: After a thorough investigation, Conan concludes there was never a painting behind the cloth and that it was suspended by a fishing line.
episodes.title: Phantom Thief Kid and the 4 Masterpieces (2)

episodes.synopsis: Kogoro takes Ran Mori and Conan to an onsen in a rental car after being given a special deal. Kogoro then receives a call from Inspector Megure who reveals that a bomber called the police station to tell them a bomb was placed on Kogoro 's car and will detonate when his speed goes below twenty km/h.
episodes.title: The Out of Control Rental Car

episodes.synopsis: Conan's class finds a wallet with a message from Ran ten years ago. Conan shares the story of how it got there by explaining the adventure he had in the past.
episodes.title: Jimmy Kudo's Childhood Adventure (1)

episodes.synopsis: Shinichi solves the riddle and heads to the school and finds the next riddle on a stop sign. Back in the present time, Conan realizes what the riddle actually means.
episodes.title: Jimmy Kudo's Childhood Adventure (2)

episodes.synopsis: Eri Kisaki is visited by Ran and Conan who came to remind her it is the anniversary of her first date with Kogoro
episodes.title: Love of Lawyer Eva Kadan

episodes.synopsis: Kogoro takes Conan out to look for a restaurant in the city and witnesses a hit and run resulting in two pedestrians being injured. A witness reveals he saw the car waited for those two before speeding into their direction and Conan concludes it was an attempted murder.
episodes.title: Bad Luck Grand Prix

episodes.synopsis: Agasa takes the Junior Detective League to a cheesecake bakery. Genta however decides to remain in the underground parking lot and continues to kick a soccer ball against a wall. When Genta hears a strange sound, he misses his kick and subsequently losses balance and falls on his head causing him to lose consciousness
episodes.title: George's Certain Kill Shot (1)

episodes.synopsis: The police gather the three suspects together where Conan reveals the culprit
episodes.title: George's Certain Kill Shot (2)

episodes.synopsis: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are in a mall when a murder occurs on the third floor. The police arrive and seal the mall preventing people from leaving the third floor and preventing public access to the mall.
episodes.title: Real 30 Minutes

episodes.synopsis: Kogoro, Ran, Conan, Heiji Hattori, and Kazuha Toyama are at a festival when a monk asks them to solve a case of a disappearing body at the temple.
episodes.title: Three Days With Harley Hartwell

episodes.synopsis: A hostess named Hiroko Inoue is found dead in her home by Osamu Kitzuka, a colleague of Inoue's to be husband Akira Taokaoka. Kitzuka had a planned meeting with Taokaoka on that day and was the reason he found the body. As Kogoro and Conan investigate, the police conclude it to be a random burglary after Taokaoka's alibi proves he was at Fukushima Prefecture during the time of Inoue's death.
episodes.title: Yellow Alibi

episodes.synopsis: Agasa takes the Junior Detective League camping, they end up being stranded in the middle of the woods. They decide to ask for lodgings from a house owned by an elderly woman named Iwae Tanaka. At the same time, Akane Ooba and her two hosts, Raito Adachi and Fuuga Kahara, also request for lodging and Tanaka complies. That night, Mitch goes to the restroom but sees something horrifying causing him to run back to his room
episodes.title: Mountain Witch's Cutlery (1)

episodes.synopsis: Tanaka dismisses Mitsuhiko's accusation as his imagination and the police continue their investigation. As Conan investigates he realizes who the murderer is.
episodes.title: Mountain Witch's Cutlery (2)

episodes.synopsis: Conan and the Junior Detective League run into Amy's neighbor, Yasuyo Akimoto, who is searching for a kind bearded policemen who she ran into multiple times last week. At the police station, they reveal they do not have an officer like that and it was against police regulation to have facial hair.
episodes.title: The Missing Policeman

episodes.synopsis: Hattori tells Conan he found someone that has knowledge on Ethan Hondou's father; However that person is dead but his grandson, Souhei Nishigun, has a photograph of Ethan's father. Conan, Vi , and Agasa travel to Nishigun's apartment and realize that someone has stolen Nishigun's photograph album and deleted the data off his computer.
episodes.title: Whereabouts of the Dark Photograph (1)

episodes.synopsis: Nishigun phones all three of his friends to ask what they were doing during the time of the robbery. Conan realizes who the culprit is from the phone calls and reveals the culprit.
episodes.title: Whereabouts of the Dark Photograph (2)

episodes.synopsis: Conan and Vi rescue a kitten from a tree and return him to his owner, Tamotsu Ishigami, the owner of a local café. A woman barges into the café exclaiming she found her boss, Kenzo Kanemaru, dead.
episodes.title: Maneki Neko from the Right to the Left

episodes.synopsis: Kogoro is invited to attend an interview of the mystery book writer Masataka Moroguichi. The next day, Moroguichi is found dead from consumption of poison. The room was locked and the key was in Moroguichi's palm; The only opening to the room is a small window which can only fit a small child.
episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 8 Left Hand's Ring Finger

episodes.synopsis: Yoko Okino takes the Junior Detective League to a TV studio for a tour. When they run into Onizuka Satan, a vocalist for a visual kei rock band. The Junior Detective League decide to search for his room to get his autograph.
episodes.title: Devil of the TV Station

episodes.synopsis: Eri Kisaki is asked to defend Hiroaki Takeuchi who had been accused of Hit and Run incident. However the evidence suggests it was his wife, Mariko Takeuchi, who was committed the crime.
episodes.title: Courtroom Confrontation III Prosecutor as Eyewitness

episodes.synopsis: Hattori tells Conan that he met a better Detective than Conan during his middle school years and reminisces about the case.
episodes.title: Harley Hartwell vs. Jimmy Kudo! The Grand Deduction Battle!
